faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the JNCASR Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Fellow position at JNCASR is 20 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science or a Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in a Professional Course with a valid score in any national-level examination. An MSc in Chemistry and CSIR-NET qualification are desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Junior Research Fellow position is 28 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 37,000/- per month, plus 27% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the JNCASR Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your resume and required documents to the official email address specified in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position will involve an Online Interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Junior Research Fellow is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the Jawaharlal Nehru Centre for Advanced Scientific Research located?
faq.answer: Jawaharlal Nehru Centre for Advanced Scientific Research is located in Bengaluru, Karnataka, with the pincode 560064.
